scope: restricted POSIX shell, actual CGI, stateful SDK fixture and local TCP socket; no ONU or external server
checks: IPv4/port/tag validation rejects shell syntax and invalid values
background worker records boot/PON/SFP without a browser and releases locks
rotation retains at most two 32 KiB files
event text cannot introduce shell syntax
firmware/settings write lock prevents SDK polling
real TCP delivery uses RFC 5424 header and RFC 6587 octet counting
logging CGI requires authentication and CSRF and rejects unknown fields
partial configuration merges, validates and verifies saved values
read, clear and disabled-remote test are fixed CGI operations
